label: T3_COVERAGE_v1
question: Does T3's question -- min{C : the invariant holds for the target at scale C} -- even PARSE on each benchmark item? A screen that is undefined on most boards is not a screen, whatever arm 3 says about the boards where it is defined.
assessed_by: this session, single rater, with hindsight of every after-board. A coverage judgement (does the question parse?) rather than a verdict, which is why it is recorded despite that.

items.scale_parameter: the side C of the target cube
items.computation: min{C : gamma_n(cube_C) >= 1/2} = sqrt(2 ln n)(1-o(1)) for the measure invariant; O(1) for the directional-TV invariant
items.note: the item T3 was derived from, so it cannot count as evidence for T3

items.computation: min{delta : the matrix-Chernoff invariant certifies a 1/2+eps split} ~ 1/log n against a dimension-free truth -- so T3 locates the log n without reference to the move
items.note: T3 would catch this board's cap, and the leak taxonomy independently calls it ACCUMULATION

items.computation: min{t : per-set Chernoff plus a union bound over n sets certifies t} = Theta(sqrt(n log n)), against the truth 6 sqrt n -- the sqrt(log n) is in the threshold, not in the move

items.why_not: the invariant is a density INCREMENT, delta -> delta + c delta^2, not a threshold on a scale. 'min{C : the invariant holds at scale C}' does not parse: the loss is rounds x per-round cost, so the question to ask is the ACCUMULATION one.
the invariant is a recursive inequality on J with a fixed fraction recovered per round. Again rounds x cost, with no scale parameter for a threshold to sit on.
value decay under k-fold repetition with size multiplicative in the exponent. The cap is the blow-up over rounds, not a threshold.

finding: T3 applies exactly where the invariant is a THRESHOLD ON A SCALE, and is undefined where the loss is rounds times per-step cost. So T3 and the leak taxonomy are COMPLEMENTARY rather than overlapping: T3 covers the boards whose cost is paid at initialisation, ACCUMULATION covers the boards whose cost is paid per step. Neither subsumes the other, and a board can be read by exactly one of them.
consequence_for_the_prompt: T3 must be askable and ANSWERABLE WITH 'does not parse for this board', the same way the five slots allow 'none recorded'. A respondent forced to produce a threshold where none exists will invent one, which is the failure mode the slot table's 'do not invent one to fill the table' clause exists to prevent.
what_would_change_this: a second rater on the coverage column alone -- does T3's question parse, yes or no, on 6 items. Two categories, six items, and it is cheaper than any other test outstanding.
